_note: Interactive Speaking : 2 thèmes par séance, 3 à 4 questions chacun, posées à l'oral (entendues une seule fois), 35 s par réponse. Guide 2026 §4.6.

questions: What do you do for a living, or what would you like to do?
What do you enjoy most about this kind of work?
How do you think this job will change in the future?
What advice would you give someone who wants to do the same job?
What are you studying at the moment, or what did you study?
How do you usually organize your study time?
What is the hardest part of learning something new for you?
Do you think exams are a good way to measure what students know? Why?
Where did you go on your last holiday?
What do you usually do first when you arrive in a new place?
Do you prefer to plan everything in advance or to improvise? Why?
How has travelling changed the way you see your own country?
Which device do you use the most in your daily life?
What did you use it for yesterday?
Do you think you spend too much time on screens? Why or why not?
Should schools teach students how to use technology responsibly?
Where did you grow up?
What is your favorite place there, and why?
How has your hometown changed since you were a child?
Would you like to live there in the future? Explain.
What do you do to stay in shape?
How often do you exercise during a typical week?
Why do you think many people stop exercising after a few weeks?
Should companies give employees time to exercise during the day?
What did you eat for dinner yesterday?
Do you enjoy cooking? Why or why not?
How are your eating habits different from your parents' habits?
Do you think people should eat less meat? Explain your view.
What do you like to do on weekends?
When did you start this activity?
Do you prefer spending your free time alone or with others? Why?
Do people today have enough free time? Explain.
Do you usually plan how you spend your money?
What was the last thing you bought that you really needed?
Is it easy for young people to save money today? Why?
Should people use cash less often? Explain your opinion.
What do you do at home to reduce waste?
Is recycling easy where you live?
Who has more responsibility for the environment: individuals or companies?
What will be the biggest environmental challenge in twenty years?
How did you meet your best friend?
What do you usually do together?
What makes someone a good friend, in your opinion?
Is it harder to make friends as an adult? Why?
What kind of music do you listen to?
When do you usually listen to music?
Have your musical tastes changed over the years? How?
Should music be a compulsory subject at school? Why?
Why are you learning English?
How long have you been studying it?
What is the most difficult part of English for you?
Will people still need to learn languages in the future, with translation apps? Explain.
Do you prefer working alone or in a team?
Describe a team project you took part in.
What problems often happen in teams, and how can they be solved?
Should schools give more group projects? Why or why not?
How do you usually get to work or school?
How long does the journey take?
What would improve public transport where you live?
Will self-driving cars be common in the future? Explain.
What is your favorite holiday or celebration?
How did you celebrate it last time?
How have celebrations changed in your family over time?
Are traditional celebrations becoming too commercial? Explain.
